subject: Closure evidence packet and bridge letter request — Clearview Bank SOC 2 follow-up
messages:
From: Ben Coleman <ben.coleman@clearviewbank.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-12-03T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + management response on Exception #4

Hi Kimberly,

Following up from Clearview's procurement security review — our audit team noted Exception #4 in the SOC 2 Type II (user access review gap for the period ending 2025-10-31). To complete our risk acceptance we need the following: 

- A redacted copy of your final SOC 2 Type II (if available) or confirmation of audit period end date.
- Your management response for Exception #4 (scope, root cause, remediation steps, and dates completed).
- Any corroborating evidence showing the fix was implemented (logs, ticket, or process doc).
- If the fix was completed after the audit window, a bridge letter or management assertion confirming compensating controls / interim mitigation.

Can you provide these items by 2025-12-16? If you already have an auditor-signed bridge letter, that would be ideal.

Thanks — we want to close this before our executive review next month. Happy to take a brief call if it's easier.

Ben Coleman
Sr. Information Security Manager | Clearview Bank
ben.coleman@clearviewbank.com
+1 617-555-0182

Attachment: none (requesting documents)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Coleman <ben.coleman@clearviewbank.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-12-03T10:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + management response on Exception #4

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear list. We can get this to you. Quick summary and next steps from our side:

- SOC 2 Type II: we are finalizing a redacted PDF; auditor has allowed limited redaction for customer distribution.
- Exception #4 (user access review): root cause was an incomplete automation rule that omitted a small set of service accounts from monthly review.
- Remediation: automation rule corrected and we ran a retroactive reconciliation on 2025-11-20. Evidence includes the remediation ticket and full reconciliation logs.

I am attaching an initial evidence packet for your review: 
- Management_Response_Exceptions.xlsx (management response + timeline)
- user_access_repair_log.csv (reconciliation output truncated)
- process_improvement_memo.pdf (controls update and new verification step)

We have asked our external auditor (Bluepoint Audit — Priya Shah) to prepare a bridge letter if the completion date is considered outside your audit window. I'll loop Priya in so she can confirm availability and expected delivery date.

If helpful, we can schedule a 20-minute call with our audit and engineering leads this week. Suggested times: Thu 12/04 10:00–11:30 PT or Fri 12/05 09:00–11:00 PT.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0247

Attachments: Management_Response_Exceptions.xlsx, user_access_repair_log.csv, process_improvement_memo.pdf
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluepointaudit.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, ben.coleman@clearviewbank.com
Date: 2025-12-05T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + management response on Exception #4

Hi Kimberly and Ben,

Thanks for the early packet, Kimberly. A few clarifying items from the auditor side so we can scope the bridge letter and any audit addendum:

1) Completion date: you state remediation completed 2025-11-20. We need evidence that the fix was fully operational immediately after that date — specifically, timestamped reconciliation logs and a confirmation that the automation rule change was deployed to production with change control.

2) Scope of impact: confirm the number of identities (users/service accounts) affected and whether any elevated privileges were altered as part of the remediation.

3) Compensating controls: if you had additional monitoring or detective controls in place during the affected period, please list with evidence.

If you can provide the requested artifacts we will draft a bridge letter template and indicate whether the exception is considered remediated as of 11/20 or whether the remediation is treated as post-period (which changes the wording). 

I've attached an auditor request checklist to help consolidate items. If we get the artifacts by COB Monday (2025-12-08) we should be able to deliver a signed bridge letter by 2025-12-10.

- Priya Shah
Partner, Bluepoint Audit
priya.shah@bluepointaudit.com | +1 206-555-0913

Attachment: auditor_request_checklist.docx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Coleman <ben.coleman@clearviewbank.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluepointaudit.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-12-08T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + management response on Exception #4 — Evidence bundle and next steps

Hi Ben / Priya — thanks for the checklist, Priya. Attached is the consolidated evidence bundle and our proposed bridge letter draft. Short summary of what we included and why it should support a remediated status as of 2025-11-20: 

Included artifacts (in closure_evidence_bundle.zip):
- SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf — redacted copy of the final report (audit period 2025-01-01 through 2025-10-31).
- Management_Response_Exceptions.xlsx — detailed remediation plan, owners, and completion dates.
- user_access_repair_log.csv — timestamped reconciliation output showing reconciliation run and final state (first reconciliation after fix ran 2025-11-20T02:14:03Z).
- process_improvement_memo.pdf — control changes and the new monthly verification checklist.
- bridge_letter_draft.docx — our draft wording for auditor review.

Key facts:
- Root cause: automation rule excluded service accounts A/B/C due to a matching issue in the identity source.
- Fix deployed: 2025-11-19 (code change and change-control ticket attached in bundle).
- Reconciled: 2025-11-20 (run id and log included).
- Affected objects: 7 service accounts; no human user privilege escalations were involved.
- Compensating controls: increased monitoring (SIEM alerts) and manual verification added for the subsequent two monthly cycles (evidence included).

Requested next steps:
1) Priya: please confirm whether Bluepoint considers the exception remediated as of 2025-11-20 and, if so, provide an auditor-signed bridge letter using the attached draft. If post-period language is required, please indicate the exact wording so we can pass that to Clearview.
2) Ben: once we have the signed bridge letter we can share the redacted SOC 2 PDF and the signed management assertion and hope that satisfies Clearview's procurement needs.

If you'd like to review live, we can do a short call tomorrow 12/09 09:00–09:30 PT.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0247

Attachments: closure_evidence_bundle.zip, bridge_letter_draft.docx
